hero.title:
Make anything
from seven pieces
hero.lead: A cat, a house, a boat. Just drag the pieces into place. Solve on screen, or print it on paper.
hero.note: Runs in your browser — nothing to install or pay for.
hero.shotAlt: Tangram play screen — the shape to match on the left, seven scattered pieces on the right

kid.title: For kids solving alone
kid.desc: Works even before they can read.
kid.point1: Difficulty shown as shapes, not numbers
kid.point2: Sound and vibration when a piece fits

adult.title: For planning a lesson
adult.desc: Pick what you need and print it all at once.
adult.point3: Include answer sheets if you want

step1.title: Pick a puzzle
step1.desc: Filter by difficulty and theme to find a shape.

step2.title: Fit the pieces
step2.desc: Drag, rotate and flip to fill the outline.

step3.title: Finish or print
step3.desc: Solve it on screen, or download a PDF.

signup.a: No. Solving, creating and downloading PDFs all work without signing up.

age.a: Easy puzzles work from about age five. Difficulty is shown as shapes rather than words, so kids who cannot read yet can still choose.

print.q: What does the printout look like?
print.a: An A4 sheet with the puzzle and an answer page. You can bundle several puzzles into one file.

create.a: Yes. Arrange the pieces and save — it appears under community puzzles. Good ones get promoted to the featured list.

school.q: Can I use it in a classroom?
school.a: Yes. You are free to use the printouts as teaching material.

closing.title: Give it a try
closing.sub: No sign-up, no install, no payment.
